LESSON: FOOD NUTRIENTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.4: Food Nutrients

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Food Nutrients. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Food Nutrients
2. Practise Food Nutrients at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food Nutrients

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Food Nutrients
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Food Nutrients. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Food Nutrients at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Food Nutrients at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food Nutrients
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Food Nutrients. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Food Nutrients using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Food Nutrients in the examples.
2. Explain Food Nutrients to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Food Nutrients.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Food Nutrients using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Food Nutrients important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Food Nutrients
2. Practise Food Nutrients at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food Nutrients

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
